meaning: Per-sense argument, UNITING-CAUSE_3 (causing being): the uniter causes the composite's being, and nothing causes its own being, so the uniter is distinct from the composite. This route drops STMT-UNITING-CAUSE-IS-EFFICIENT and STMT-NOTHING-IS-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-OF-ITSELF, using the open premise STMT-NOTHING-CAUSES-ITS-OWN-BEING instead.
